justification: `javaparser-symbol-solver-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/symbolsolver/javassistmodel/JavassistMethodDeclaration.java` is only 147 lines and consists of a constructor plus a small set of method-metadata accessors. Most behavior is delegated to `JavassistMethodLikeDeclarationAdapter`, `JavassistFactory`, or `MethodDeclarationCommonLogic`; the class mainly wraps a `CtMethod` and exposes the `ResolvedMethodDeclaration` API. The sibling adapter `JavassistMethodLikeDeclarationAdapter.java` centralizes parameter/type-parameter/exception parsing, which keeps this class cohesive rather than decomposed poorly. `javaparser-symbol-solver-testing/src/test/java/com/github/javaparser/symbolsolver/javassistmodel/JavassistMethodDeclarationTest.java` also exercises a single concern: method signature, parameter, and exception metadata.
